title: ONEM1ND
note: ONEM1ND, the one board of the version, in Modern: setup, the Map with its groups, chats and what waits on you, Blueprint, Void, settings and the service, the phone. Blueprint and Void share one library and one comment composer. Every press answers at once and every wait ends with a clear state. Present plays each row in order. The sample is invented.

screens.title: 1.2 Setup and first run: Where the M1ND lives

kids.name: text
kids.value: The M1ND holds your units, chats, boards and texts. Relay is optimized to run in cloud storage services for free syncing of your preferences.

kids.name: text
kids.value: A HIVEM1ND 2.x M1ND was found in C:\Users\you\OneDrive\HIVEM1ND. It is copied and upgraded; the original stays untouched.

kids.name: text

kids.name: text
kids.value: The service is running on DESKTOP. To add another machine, install ONEM1ND there and choose the same M1ND folder.

kids.name: text
kids.value: ONEM1ND 3.0 brings every agent of the M1ND onto one Map. Units are created where they run, and every conversation is kept.

kids.name: text
kids.value: Each machine runs one Relay service while ONEM1ND needs it. It wakes the sessions on that machine and starts new ones from the Map.

kids.name: text
kids.value: Every unit has a mailbox for messages left while it is not running. A chat opens its own inbox, so a conversation with one unit or a group stays in one place.

kids.name: text
kids.value: Agents draw in Blueprint and write in Void through the service. The person watches a step at a time, or lets the work run off screen.

kids.name: text
kids.value: Select a passage to comment on it or to ask the agent for a change.

screens.title: 6.1 Settings, the phone link and the service: Settings

kids.name: text
kids.value: Each preview is drawn in the look's own palette; a choice applies at once.

kids.name: text
kids.value: See, chat and approve from your phone while it is on the same network. Access closes after 12 hours.

kids.name: text
kids.value: Sync your preferences on any device, phones included, through the same service as Nebula+.

screens.title: 6.2 Settings, the phone link and the service: Agents

kids.name: text
kids.value: The command line is how ONEM1ND runs your units: it opens a session for each task and closes it. Auto loads the M1ND rules in every session; On demand only when a ONEM1ND command runs.

kids.name: text
kids.value: The desktop app is separate and optional: connecting it lets you write to an agent in its own window, and the M1ND wakes it when a message arrives.

kids.name: text
kids.value: A unit can also be run by hand in an agent's app with its command, for example /executor shop. It joins the M1ND, keeps its place in the hierarchy and shows on the Map like any other.

kids.name: text
kids.value: Type the code shown on your computer, in Settings, Open on the phone.

kids.name: text
kids.value: Or scan the QR code with the camera.
